title: Every sign-in asks for a second step: the password alone gives an unverified session, a 6-digit code is emailed to a masked address, and only the email method is offered without an authenticator
evidence: login 200; methods ["email"]; hint r******@gate.test; code emailed true; app before code 403 mfa_verification_required

title: The emailed code opens the session; it works once and only for the sign-in that asked for it
evidence: code in another sign-in 422; own sign-in 200; app after 200; reuse 422

title: Wrong codes: five wrong entries withdraw the code (the right code then fails); a new code can be requested and works
evidence: wrong 422,422,422,422,422; right code after 5 wrong 422; resend 200; new code 200

title: An expired code (over 10 minutes) is refused
Resending within 30 seconds in the same sign-in waits; a second sign-in gets its own code at once; at most 10 codes per 15 minutes
evidence: resend at once 429 mfa_email_wait; second sign-in code true; 11th code mfa_email_rate_limited

title: The code is stored only as a keyed hash
"Trust this device": after a code with the box ticked, that browser signs in without a code; the cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, 30 days; other browsers still get a code
evidence: verify 200; flags HttpOnly,Secure,SameSite=Strict; max-age 2592000s; trusted browser asked false; other browser asked true

title: A trust token does not work from another browser (user agent), for another account, after expiry, or when tampered with
evidence: asked for a code: other browser true, other account true, tampered true, expired true

title: Trust is withdrawn by a password change, an administrator MFA reset and "Forget trusted devices" (password needed)
evidence: password change 200, asked after true; admin reset 200, asked true; forget without password 401, with 200, asked true

title: The authenticator app is optional: setup needs the password and returns a QR-ready otpauth link; a correct code turns it on and returns 10 recovery codes
evidence: before: enrolled false, methods ["email"]; setup without password 401; otpauth ok true; recovery codes 10

title: With an authenticator, sign-in offers email, authenticator and recovery; the authenticator code works once (replay refused)
A recovery code works once and ends the account's other sessions and trusted devices
evidence: recovery 200; other session 401; reuse 422; trusted device asked again true

title: The person can remove the authenticator (password needed); sign-in then offers the emailed code only
The authenticator secret is stored encrypted (the base32 key is not in the database)
evidence: cipher 32 bytes; plain key present false

title: Before the second step only sign-in routes answer; accounting, admin and settings routes are refused
evidence: companies 403, workspace 403, admin/users 403, auth/mfa/devices 403, platform/invitations 403; me 200 (verified false); status 200

title: With only the password, adding an authenticator cannot replace the emailed code (setup, removal, recovery codes and trusted devices need a verified session)
evidence: setup 403, confirm 403, remove 403, recovery codes 403, devices 403; app still blocked 403; authenticator rows 0

title: Browser: the sign-in screen says "Check your email" with the masked address and the trust box; Account & Access shows a QR code for the optional authenticator
evidence: title "Check your email"; hint r******@gate.test; trust box true; trusted-device cookie set true; QR on screen 200x200px, decodes to the setup link with this key true; key VFG6 3G7K…; page errors 0
